notes.text: The complete sequence includes reports, directions of address, bare names, asserted kinship, references, and explicit doubts. Parallel versions name Abaye or Sheshet for the interpreter, the Jerusalem quotations may read Chasida, and the Beitzah witness gives Rava beside the received Rabbah. Direct Shabbat address and contextual name forms differ from the attributed Maharshal and Rabbenu Tam readings.
